author: ch402
text:
One of the biggest advantages of openness -- in research, in personal thinking, and life broadly -- is that it prevents evaporation.

Many of my thoughts and experiences have been lost or become illegible over time. The things I shared publicly remain.

author: ch402
text:
I think techniques like this may have an essential role in getting systems to do the right thing *for the right reason*.

In turn, this seems to me to be at the core of building safe, aligned, fair AI systems that robustly reflect our values in the future.

author: ch402
text: Super interesting table -- disability weights try to quantify the harm of different conditions. Calculated by interviewing lots of people about trades they'd make. They can be useful for putting different interventions in common units (the Disability Adjusted Life Year). https://t.co/uujGK9Crpd
